fullText.simplified:
又生气又难过

    天黑了，孙策和太史慈还在打。过了一会儿，下雨了，他们就在雨里打。雨越下越大，他们都看不清东西了。
    孙策说：“今天不打了，明天再打。”
    太史慈说：“好，明天我带军队来和你打。”
    孙策大笑：“好，你有多少人就带多少人来，我等你！”
    太史慈回去了。他很高兴，觉得如果没有下雨，他可以和孙策再打一会儿。如果可以再打一会儿，他就能打败孙策了。他想马上告诉刘要，不用跑，也不用害怕，他真的能打败孙策。
    他笑着回去，但是马上，他脸上的笑就没有了。因为他发现，刘要又带着军队跑了。就在他努力打孙策的时候，刘要已经跑了。没有人关心他打得怎么样，也没有人关心他会不会死，更没有人等他，大家都跑了。他一个人站在雨里，又生气又难过，他觉得自己太好笑了。
    第二天，太史慈又想了想，他是刘要的兵，刘要跑了，他不能跑。他决定找到刘要，再好好和他说一说，他们可以打败孙策。
    他找了十多天，找到了刘要的军队，但是没有见到刘要。这十多天里，孙策的军队和刘要的军队又打了几次，刘要的军队很怕孙策，总是边打边跑。孙策的军队越打越好，人也越来越多，最后一仗打了两天，刘要还是败了。军队没有了，刘要一个人跑了。他离开江东，去了很远的地方。
    现在，曲阿是孙策的了，他的军队也有一万人了。孙策很高兴，这是他早就想做的事，他要得到江东的每一个城市，江东只能有一个主人。他做了江东的主人，江东就会变安静，他一定要让江东变好。
fullText.traditional:
又生氣又難過

    天黑了，孫策和太史慈還在打。過了一會兒，下雨了，他們就在雨裡打。雨越下越大，他們都看不清東西了。
    孫策說：“今天不打了，明天再打。”
    太史慈說：“好，明天我帶軍隊來和你打。”
    孫策大笑：“好，你有多少人就帶多少人來，我等你！”
    太史慈回去了。他很高興，覺得如果沒有下雨，他可以和孫策再打一會兒。如果可以再打一會兒，他就能打敗孫策了。他想馬上告訴劉要，不用跑，也不用害怕，他真的能打敗孫策。
    他笑著回去，但是馬上，他臉上的笑就沒有了。因為他發現，劉要又帶著軍隊跑了。就在他努力打孫策的時候，劉要已經跑了。沒有人關心他打得怎麼樣，也沒有人關心他會不會死，更沒有人等他，大家都跑了。他一個人站在雨裡，又生氣又難過，他覺得自己太好笑了。
    第二天，太史慈又想了想，他是劉要的兵，劉要跑了，他不能跑。他決定找到劉要，再好好和他說一說，他們可以打敗孫策。
    他找了十多天，找到了劉要的軍隊，但是沒有見到劉要。這十多天裡，孫策的軍隊和劉要的軍隊又打了幾次，劉要的軍隊很怕孫策，總是邊打邊跑。孫策的軍隊越打越好，人也越來越多，最後一仗打了兩天，劉要還是敗了。軍隊沒有了，劉要一個人跑了。他離開江東，去了很遠的地方。
    現在，曲阿是孫策的了，他的軍隊也有一萬人了。孫策很高興，這是他早就想做的事，他要得到江東的每一個城市，江東只能有一個主人。他做了江東的主人，江東就會變安靜，他一定要讓江東變好。

sentences.simplified: 天黑了，孙策和太史慈还在打。
sentences.traditional: 天黑了，孫策和太史慈還在打。
sentences.pinyin: tiān hēi le sūn cè hé tài shǐ cí hái zài dǎ
sentences.english: It was already dark, and Sun Ce and Taishi Ci were still fighting.

sentences.simplified: 过了一会儿，下雨了，他们就在雨里打。
sentences.traditional: 過了一會兒，下雨了，他們就在雨裡打。
sentences.pinyin: guò le yí huì'r xià yǔ le tā men jiù zài yǔ lǐ dǎ
sentences.english: After some time, it started raining, so they fought in the rain.

sentences.simplified: 雨越下越大，他们都看不清东西了。
sentences.traditional: 雨越下越大，他們都看不清東西了。
sentences.pinyin: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà tā men dōu kàn bù qīng dōng xi le
sentences.english: The rain became heavier and heavier, and they couldn’t see clearly.

sentences.simplified: 孙策说：“今天不打了，明天再打。”
sentences.traditional: 孫策說：“今天不打了，明天再打。”
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè shuō jīn tiān bù dǎ le míng tiān zài dǎ
sentences.english: Sun Ce said, “Let’s stop fighting today. We’ll continue fighting tomorrow.”

sentences.simplified: 太史慈说：“好，明天我带军队来和你打。”
sentences.traditional: 太史慈說：“好，明天我帶軍隊來和你打。”
sentences.pinyin: tài shǐ cí shuō hǎo míng tiān wǒ dài jūn duì lái hé nǐ dǎ
sentences.english: Taishi Ci said, “Okay, tomorrow I’ll bring my troops to fight you.”

sentences.simplified: 孙策大笑：“好，你有多少人就带多少人来，我等你！”
sentences.traditional: 孫策大笑：“好，你有多少人就帶多少人來，我等你！”
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè dà xiào hǎo nǐ yǒu duō shao rén jiù dài duō shao rén lái wǒ děng nǐ
sentences.english: Sun Ce laughed loudly: “Okay, bring all the men you have. I’ll wait for you!”

sentences.simplified: 太史慈回去了。他很高兴，觉得如果没有下雨，他可以和孙策再打一会儿。
sentences.traditional: 太史慈回去了。他很高興，覺得如果沒有下雨，他可以和孫策再打一會兒。
sentences.pinyin: tài shǐ cí huí qù le tā hěn gāo xìng jué de rú guǒ méi yǒu xià yǔ tā kě yǐ hé sūn cè zài dǎ yí huì'r
sentences.english: Taishi Ci returned. He was very happy and felt that if it hadn’t started raining, he could have fought Sun Ce for a while longer.

sentences.simplified: 如果可以再打一会儿，他就能打败孙策了。
sentences.traditional: 如果可以再打一會兒，他就能打敗孫策了。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ kě yǐ zài dǎ yí huì'r tā jiù néng dǎ bài sūn cè le
sentences.english: If he could have fought for a while longer, he could have defeated Sun Ce.

sentences.simplified: 他想马上告诉刘要，不用跑，也不用害怕，他真的能打败孙策。
sentences.traditional: 他想馬上告訴劉要，不用跑，也不用害怕，他真的能打敗孫策。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng mǎ shàng gào su liú yào bú yòng pǎo yě bú yòng hài pà tā zhēn de néng dǎ bài sūn cè
sentences.english: He wanted to tell Liu Yao right away that they did not need to run away and did not need to be afraid. He really could defeat Sun Ce.

sentences.simplified: 他笑着回去，但是马上，他脸上的笑就没有了。
sentences.traditional: 他笑著回去，但是馬上，他臉上的笑就沒有了。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiào zhe huí qù dàn shì mǎ shàng tā liǎn shang de xiào jiù méi yǒu le
sentences.english: He returned, smiling, but right away, his smile disappeared.

sentences.simplified: 因为他发现，刘要又带着军队跑了。
sentences.traditional: 因為他發現，劉要又帶著軍隊跑了。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā fā xiàn liú yào yòu dài zhe jūn duì pǎo le
sentences.english: Because he discovered that Liu Yao had run away with his troops again.

sentences.simplified: 就在他努力打孙策的时候，刘要已经跑了。
sentences.traditional: 就在他努力打孫策的時候，劉要已經跑了。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zài tā nǔ lì dǎ sūn cè de shí hou liú yào yǐ jīng pǎo le
sentences.english: As he was working hard to fight Sun Ce, Liu Yao had already run away.

sentences.simplified: 没有人关心他打得怎么样，也没有人关心他会不会死，更没有人等他，大家都跑了。
sentences.traditional: 沒有人關心他打得怎麼樣，也沒有人關心他會不會死，更沒有人等他，大家都跑了。
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu rén guān xīn tā dǎ de zěn me yàng yě méi yǒu rén guān xīn tā huì bú huì sǐ gèng méi yǒu rén děng tā dà jiā dōu pǎo le
sentences.english: No one cared about how his fight was going, no one cared whether he was going to die, and no one waited for him. Everyone ran away.

sentences.simplified: 他一个人站在雨里，又生气又难过，他觉得自己太好笑了。
sentences.traditional: 他一個人站在雨裡，又生氣又難過，他覺得自己太好笑了。
sentences.pinyin: tā yí ge rén zhàn zài yǔ lǐ yòu shēng qì yòu nán guò tā jué de zì jǐ tài hǎo xiào le
sentences.english: He stood alone in the rain. He was angry and upset. He thought that he was too ridiculous.

sentences.simplified: 第二天，太史慈又想了想，他是刘要的兵，刘要跑了，他不能跑。
sentences.traditional: 第二天，太史慈又想了想，他是劉要的兵，劉要跑了，他不能跑。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr tiān tài shǐ cí yòu xiǎng le xiǎng tā shì liú yào de bīng liú yào pǎo le tā bù néng pǎo
sentences.english: The next day, Taishi Ci thought about it again. He was Liu Yao’s soldier. Even if Liu Yao ran away, he could not run away.

sentences.simplified: 他决定找到刘要，再好好和他说一说，他们可以打败孙策。
sentences.traditional: 他決定找到劉要，再好好和他說一說，他們可以打敗孫策。
sentences.pinyin: tā jué dìng zhǎo dào liú yào zài hǎo hǎo hé tā shuō yì shuō tā men kě yǐ dǎ bài sūn cè
sentences.english: He decided that he was going to find Liu Yao and have a good talk with him. They could defeat Sun Ce.

sentences.simplified: 他找了十多天，找到了刘要的军队，但是没有见到刘要。
sentences.traditional: 他找了十多天，找到了劉要的軍隊，但是沒有見到劉要。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǎo le shí duō tiān zhǎo dào le liú yào de jūn duì dàn shì méi yǒu jiàn dào liú yào
sentences.english: He looked for 10 days and found Liu Yao’s troops, but he did not see Liu Yao.

sentences.simplified: 这十多天里，孙策的军队和刘要的军队又打了几次，
sentences.traditional: 這十多天裡，孫策的軍隊和劉要的軍隊又打了幾次，
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí duō tiān lǐ sūn cè de jūn duì hé liú yào de jūn duì yòu dǎ le jǐ cì
sentences.english: In these 10 or so days, Sun Ce’s troops and Liu Yao’s troops fought a few more times.

sentences.simplified: 刘要的军队很怕孙策，总是边打边跑。
sentences.traditional: 劉要的軍隊很怕孫策，總是邊打邊跑。
sentences.pinyin: liú yào de jūn duì hěn pà sūn cè zǒng shì biān dǎ biān pǎo
sentences.english: Liu Yao’s troops were very afraid of Sun Ce, and they always ran away while fighting.

sentences.simplified: 孙策的军队越打越好，人也越来越多，
sentences.traditional: 孫策的軍隊越打越好，人也越來越多，
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè de jūn duì yuè dǎ yuè hǎo rén yě yuè lái yuè duō
sentences.english: Sun Ce’s troops got better and better the more they fought, and they also gathered more and more men.

sentences.simplified: 最后一仗打了两天，刘要还是败了。
sentences.traditional: 最後一仗打了兩天，劉要還是敗了。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu yí zhàng dǎ le liǎng tiān liú yào hái shi bài le
sentences.english: The last battle was fought for two days, and in the end, Liu Yao was defeated.

sentences.simplified: 军队没有了，刘要一个人跑了。他离开江东，去了很远的地方。
sentences.traditional: 軍隊沒有了，劉要一個人跑了。他離開江東，去了很遠的地方。
sentences.pinyin: jūn duì méi yǒu le liú yào yí ge rén pǎo le tā lí kāi jiāng dōng qù le hěn yuǎn de dì fang
sentences.english: Liu Yao had no more troops and ran away alone. He left Jiangdong and went to a place very far away.

sentences.simplified: 现在，曲阿是孙策的了，他的军队也有一万人了。
sentences.traditional: 現在，曲阿是孫策的了，他的軍隊也有一萬人了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài qǔ ā shì sūn cè de le tā de jūn duì yě yǒu yí wàn rén le
sentences.english: Now, Qu’a belonged to Sun Ce, and he had 10,000 troops.

sentences.simplified: 孙策很高兴，这是他早就想做的事，
sentences.traditional: 孫策很高興，這是他早就想做的事，
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè hěn gāo xìng zhè shì tā zǎo jiù xiǎng zuò de shì
sentences.english: Sun Ce was very happy. This was something he had wanted to do for a long time.

sentences.simplified: 他要得到江东的每一个城市，江东只能有一个主人。
sentences.traditional: 他要得到江東的每一個城市，江東只能有一個主人。
sentences.pinyin: tā yào dé dào jiāng dōng de měi yí ge chéng shì jiāng dōng zhǐ néng yǒu yí ge zhǔ rén
sentences.english: He wanted to capture every city in Jiangdong. There could only be one master of Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 他做了江东的主人，江东就会变安静，
sentences.traditional: 他做了江東的主人，江東就會變安靜，
sentences.pinyin: tā zuò le jiāng dōng de zhǔ rén jiāng dōng jiù huì biàn ān jìng
sentences.english: If he became the master of Jiangdong, Jiangdong would become peaceful.

sentences.simplified: 他一定要让江东变好。
sentences.traditional: 他一定要讓江東變好。
sentences.pinyin: tā yí dìng yào ràng jiāng dōng biàn hǎo
sentences.english: He was going to make Jiangdong a better place.

sentence_translations: Angry and Upset
It was already dark, and Sun Ce and Taishi Ci were still fighting.
After some time, it started raining, so they fought in the rain.
The rain became heavier and heavier, and they couldn’t see clearly.
Sun Ce said, “Let’s stop fighting today. We’ll continue fighting tomorrow.”
Taishi Ci said, “Okay, tomorrow I’ll bring my troops to fight you.”
Sun Ce laughed loudly: “Okay, bring all the men you have. I’ll wait for you!”
Taishi Ci returned. He was very happy and felt that if it hadn’t started raining, he could have fought Sun Ce for a while longer.
If he could have fought for a while longer, he could have defeated Sun Ce.
He wanted to tell Liu Yao right away that they did not need to run away and did not need to be afraid. He really could defeat Sun Ce.
He returned, smiling, but right away, his smile disappeared.
Because he discovered that Liu Yao had run away with his troops again.
As he was working hard to fight Sun Ce, Liu Yao had already run away.
No one cared about how his fight was going, no one cared whether he was going to die, and no one waited for him. Everyone ran away.
He stood alone in the rain. He was angry and upset. He thought that he was too ridiculous.
The next day, Taishi Ci thought about it again. He was Liu Yao’s soldier. Even if Liu Yao ran away, he could not run away.
He decided that he was going to find Liu Yao and have a good talk with him. They could defeat Sun Ce.
He looked for 10 days and found Liu Yao’s troops, but he did not see Liu Yao.
In these 10 or so days, Sun Ce’s troops and Liu Yao’s troops fought a few more times.
Liu Yao’s troops were very afraid of Sun Ce, and they always ran away while fighting.
Sun Ce’s troops got better and better the more they fought, and they also gathered more and more men.
The last battle was fought for two days, and in the end, Liu Yao was defeated.
Liu Yao had no more troops and ran away alone. He left Jiangdong and went to a place very far away.
Now, Qu’a belonged to Sun Ce, and he had 10,000 troops.
Sun Ce was very happy. This was something he had wanted to do for a long time.
He wanted to capture every city in Jiangdong. There could only be one master of Jiangdong.
If he became the master of Jiangdong, Jiangdong would become peaceful.
He was going to make Jiangdong a better place.
